gloss: one's height; one's means; one's capacity

definitions.explanation: A person's physical height or body size.

definitions.gloss: one's means; one's capacity; what is within one's reach
definitions.explanation: One's actual ability, financial means, or social standing. Used figuratively to talk about living or acting within one's realistic limits.

examples.japanese: {身|み}の{丈|たけ}ほどの{大|おお}きな{荷物|にもつ}を{抱|かか}えていた。
examples.english: He was carrying a package as tall as himself.

examples.japanese: {身|み}の{丈|たけ}を{超|こ}えるほどの{雪|ゆき}が{積|つ}もった。
examples.english: Snow piled up higher than a person's height.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{身|み}の{丈|たけ}ほどもある{刀|かたな}を{背負|せお}っていた。
examples.english: He was carrying a sword on his back that was as long as he was tall.

examples.japanese: {身|み}の{丈|たけ}に{合|あ}った{生活|せいかつ}をする。
{身|み}の{丈|たけ}に{合|あ}わない{買|か}い{物|もの}はしないようにしている。
examples.english: I try not to make purchases beyond my means.

examples.japanese: {無理|むり}をせず、{身|み}の{丈|たけ}に{合|あ}った{目標|もくひょう}を{立|た}てることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to set realistic goals that match your capacity rather than overextending yourself.

notes:
Compound of {身|み} (body) + の (possessive) + {丈|たけ} (height, length). The figurative sense 2 is very common in everyday conversation and advice.

The expression {身|み}の{丈|たけ}に{合|あ}った (suited to one's means/capacity) is one of the most frequently used collocations, often appearing in financial advice, lifestyle discussions, and self-improvement contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {身|み}の{丈|たけ}に{合|あ}った (suited to one's means)
- {身|み}の{丈|たけ}に{合|あ}わない (beyond one's means)
- {身|み}の{丈|たけ}を{知|し}る (to know one's limits)
- {身|み}の{丈|たけ}ほどの (as tall/big as a person)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {身長|しんちょう}: height (physical measurement, more precise)
- {分相応|ぶんそうおう}: befitting one's station (more formal, literary)
